bullets.text: Logitech MX Master 4 Impresses - The latest mouse features haptics, premium materials, and a new action wheel.
ChatGPT App Growth Slows - Download growth has plateaued, indicating potential challenges amid rising competition.
M5 MacBook Pro Charger Confusion - New models sold in the UK lack power adapters, clarifying EU regulations.
Apple's Studio Display Rumored - Upcoming display may feature a highly-requested 120Hz refresh rate.
WhatsApp Bans General-Purpose Chatbots - New API terms restrict AI assistants, focusing on business customer support.
Wikipedia Traffic Declines - AI summaries and social video are impacting user engagement and pageviews.
GM's EV Battery Innovations - New lithium manganese rich batteries promise better range and lower costs.
YouTubers Diversify Revenue Streams - Creators are moving beyond ad revenue to build sustainable businesses.
Salesforce CEO Apologizes - Marc Benioff retracts comments about needing National Guard in San Francisco.
Amazon's Ring Expands Surveillance - New partnerships enable police to request footage from Ring users.
